diagnosis.rationale: Undiluted readings plateau at ~1.27–1.33 from 7–18 h, which looks like a stationary phase but is actually the plate reader's saturation ceiling. Dilution series of the 18 h aliquot gives corrected values that agree across dilutions: 5×→4.78, 10×→4.74 (mean of 3 reps), 20×→4.61 — all ~3.5× the undiluted reading of 1.32. A 10× dilution at 12 h likewise corrects to ~4.71 versus the undiluted 1.27, showing the underestimation persists throughout the final hours. The internal consistency of the diluted readings (in the reader's linear range) versus the compressed undiluted values demonstrates the true biomass is far higher than the undiluted readings indicate; best estimate of true OD600 at 18 h ≈ 4.7.
